skill.ba_martialarts.boxer.tooltip: Unarmed style: fast hands. Every 3rd hit is a heavy one-two. Combat Art: Crushing Uppercut.

skill.ba_martialarts.nak_muay.tooltip: Muay Thai: sturdy, knee finisher slows enemies. Combat Art: Flying Knee.
skill.ba_martialarts.kung_fu_master.tool: Kung Fu: speed and jumps, finisher launches enemies. Combat Art: Chi Palm.

skill.ba_martialarts.judoka.tooltip: Judo: throws and stability, counter throw after a dodge. Combat Art: Ippon.
skill.ba_martialarts.crushing_uppercut.t: An uppercut that launches the enemy high and weakens it.
skill.ba_martialarts.kiai.tooltip: A battle cry shockwave in a 7-block cone with strong knockback.
skill.ba_martialarts.flying_knee.tooltip: Leap to a target up to 10 blocks away and strike with the knee.
skill.ba_martialarts.chi_palm.tooltip: A 16-block energy beam piercing up to 5 enemies.
skill.ba_martialarts.tornado_kick.toolti: A spinning jump: 6 kicks hitting everyone around.
skill.ba_martialarts.ippon.tooltip: Shoulder throw: the enemy flies behind you, slowed and weakened.
skill.ba_martialarts.flurry_of_blows.too: 10 punches in one second on a single target. Works with any unarmed style.
